article.title: Books and papers of company to be evidence.
article.content: Where a company is being wound up, all books and papers of the company and of the Company Liquidator shall, as between the contributories of the company, be prima facie evidence of the truth of all matters purporting to be recorded therein.
article.html:
345Books and papers of company to be evidence.

Section 345 · Chapter XX · Part III · page 191 of the Act

Where a company is being wound up, all books and papers of the company and of the Company Liquidator shall, as between the contributories of the company, be prima facie evidence of the truth of all matters purporting to be recorded therein.
